description: Get upcoming scheduled macroeconomic release timestamps for a currency, for questions such as when the next CPI, GDP, payrolls, or policy decision is due. Returns ISO-8601 announcement_datetime values in UTC plus market-local timestamps, a markdown agenda, and Release Calendar App metadata. The optional `timezone` adds an `announcement_datetime_requested_timezone` field. Each row has a `release` string with the indicator name and a `currency` code. Unbounded calls return future releases only. The optional `indicator` filter narrows to a single series, and optional `start_date` and `end_date` bounds select a month, week, day, or explicit date range. Supported currencies: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy. The `indicator` parameter lists the accepted indicator slugs. Access: USD is available without an API key; every other currency returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

archive_event_id.description: versions only: the archive event_id from snapshot rows.

as_of.description: snapshot only: ISO 8601 knowledge cutoff ending in Z or an offset.

checkpoint.description: snapshot/versions: checkpoint from the first page.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code (case-insensitive). Supported: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy.

cursor.description: snapshot/versions: next_cursor from the previous page.

event_kind.description: snapshot only: release, speech, meeting, policy_decision, press_conference or other.

indicator.description: Optional indicator slug to narrow results. Supported: any indicator slug the FXMacroData catalogue lists for the currency, for example inflation, gdp, policy_rate, unemployment.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone for an additional converted timestamp, for example America/Sao_Paulo.

view.description: upcoming (default): scheduled releases. snapshot: the schedule as it was known at `as_of`. versions: every schedule change and cancellation for one `archive_event_id`. archive_coverage: retained official calendar evidence and known gaps.

title: Release Calendar
